features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Normalized composite of molecular size indicators V1 (log scale), V7 (branching), and V16 (ring count), capturing overall structural complexity as a smooth continuous score
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVM benefits from a single smooth composite that captures molecular complexity along a principal axis separating biodegradable from recalcitrant compounds

features.name: lipophilicity_proxy
features.description: Approximation of lipophilicity using V2 (hydrophobic descriptor) normalized by V1 (molecular size), reflecting tendency to partition into lipid phases which affects biodegradation
features.expected_model_benefit: Lipophilicity is a key driver of biodegradation; this ratio provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with SVM margin optimization

features.name: heteroatom_density
features.description: Density of heteroatoms (V3 nitrogen-like, V4 halogen-like, V6 oxygen-like counts) relative to molecular size V1, indicating functional group richness
features.expected_model_benefit: Heteroatom density captures chemical reactivity relevant to biodegradation pathways; normalized ratio is well-suited for linear decision boundaries

features.name: electronic_charge_asymmetry
features.description: Absolute deviation of partial charge descriptor V12 from zero, scaled by V13 (electronegativity-related), capturing electronic polarization of the molecule
features.expected_model_benefit: Electronic asymmetry affects enzyme recognition and biodegradation susceptibility; smooth continuous measure improves linear SVM separability

features.name: topological_branching_index
features.description: Composite branching measure combining V7 (branching count), V9 (connectivity), and V10 (path length), normalized to unit scale for linear projection
features.expected_model_benefit: Branching topology strongly influences biodegradation; this normalized index provides a smooth feature for SVM hyperplane alignment

features.name: molecular_surface_estimate
features.description: Estimate of molecular surface area using V8 (surface-related descriptor) normalized by training mean and std, providing a z-score-like continuous feature
features.expected_model_benefit: Molecular surface area affects aqueous solubility and microbial accessibility; z-score normalization is ideal for SVM margin computation

features.name: ring_system_complexity
features.description: Log-transformed count of ring-related features V16 and V33, capturing aromatic and aliphatic ring contributions to structural rigidity
features.expected_model_benefit: Ring systems reduce biodegradation rates; log transformation compresses the heavy tail for better linear separability

features.name: polarity_balance_score
features.description: Ratio of polar descriptor V14 to nonpolar size V15, capturing the hydrophilic-hydrophobic balance relevant to aqueous biodegradation
features.expected_model_benefit: Polarity balance is a key physicochemical driver; this ratio provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with linear decision boundaries

features.name: connectivity_index_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized version of V27 (Wiener-type connectivity index), a key topological descriptor for molecular graph structure
features.expected_model_benefit: Connectivity indices are strong predictors of biodegradation; z-score normalization directly supports SVM margin optimization

features.name: fragment_diversity_score
features.description: Weighted sum of diverse fragment indicators V20, V21, V24, V25, V26, V29 capturing presence of rare functional groups that affect biodegradation pathways
features.expected_model_benefit: Rare functional fragments often indicate recalcitrant structures; this weighted composite provides a smooth severity score for linear SVM

features.name: size_adjusted_polarity
features.description: Interaction between molecular size V1 and electronic descriptor V12, capturing how charge distribution scales with molecular size
features.expected_model_benefit: Size-polarity interaction captures nonlinear structure-activity relationships in a single linear feature, improving SVM margin quality

features.name: biodegradation_structural_risk
features.description: Semantic assessment of structural features associated with biodegradation difficulty: high values indicate molecules with large ring systems (V16 > 6), high halogen content (V4 > 0), low polarity (V14 < 0.5), and high molecular complexity (V1 > 5), all of which are known to reduce biodegradability. Score ranges from 0 (easily biodegradable structural profile) to 4 (highly recalcitrant structural profile).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain expertise about structural recalcitrance into a single ordinal score, providing a strong linear feature for SVM classification
